name: Deep Space, Stars and Cities: Awe and Affect Ratings
description:
Method replication: same task, scales and design as the paper; the images are not the paper's stimuli (openly licensed photographs from Wikimedia Commons: 7 James Webb Space Telescope images by NASA/ESA/CSA/STScI, 7 starry night skies and 7 urban streets without vegetation or water; creator and licence shown under each photo).

Based on Martens, Prokopetz & Tomlinson (2025), "The Influence of Deep Space and the Stars on Emotions", International Journal of Psychology 61(1): e70146. Within-subjects design: participants view three sets of 7 photographs (deep space, stars, urban) in random block order, each photo on screen for 20 seconds with the paper's instruction to observe and immerse themselves. After each set they rate the photos (pleasantness, perceived restoration, willingness to hang them in their room, 1–10), complete the 30-item Awe Experience Scale (AWE-S; six subscales: time, self-loss, connectedness, vastness, physiological, accommodation; 1–7) and the 10-item I-PANAS-SF (1–5). At the end: fear of the dark (1–10), age, gender, ethnicity, student status and education. Analysis as in the paper: repeated-measures ANOVA across the three conditions for each outcome with pairwise follow-ups.

Differences from the original study: (1) the photographs are different openly licensed images chosen with the paper's criteria (JWST images of different phenomena; naked-eye night skies; urban scenes without nature), and one star photo was cropped to remove tree silhouettes; (2) the Nature-Sky connection measure (NSCI) is omitted because its items are not openly available; (3) AWE-S wording is taken from Yaden et al. (2019) as reproduced in a CC BY validation paper; (4) online only (the paper also ran a face-to-face pilot in a darkened room).
author: Martens, Prokopetz & Tomlinson

<style>
:root{--bg:#0f1220;--card:#1a1e30;--ink:#eef0f7;--muted:#a9afc4;--accent:#8fa8ff;--line:#2d3350;--warn:#ff8a80}
*{box-sizing:border-box}html,body{margin:0;background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink);font:16px/1.5 system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",Roboto,sans-serif}
main{max-width:900px;margin:0 auto;padding:22px 16px 40px}
h1{font-size:1.45rem;margin:0 0 8px}h2{font-size:1.1rem;margin:0 0 8px}p{margin:0 0 12px;color:var(--muted)}
.card{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;padding:18px;margin-top:14px}
.btn{appearance:none;border:0;border-radius:10px;padding:12px 18px;font:inherit;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;background:var(--accent);color:#0f1220}
.btn:disabled{opacity:.4;cursor:not-allowed}
.view{background:#000;border-radius:12px;overflow:hidden;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;aspect-ratio:3/2;max-height:72vh;margin:0 auto}
.view img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:contain;display:block}
.timer{height:4px;background:var(--line);border-radius:2px;overflow:hidden;margin-top:8px}.timer>i{display:block;height:100%;background:var(--accent);width:0}
.src{font-size:.75rem;color:var(--muted);margin-top:6px;word-break:break-word}
table.m{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse}table.m th{font-size:.75rem;color:var(--muted);font-weight:500;padding:4px 2px;position:sticky;top:0;background:var(--card)}
table.m td{padding:6px 2px;border-top:1px solid var(--line);text-align:center}table.m td.t{text-align:left;padding-right:8px;font-size:.95rem}
table.m input{width:18px;height:18px;accent-color:var(--accent)}
tr.miss td.t{color:var(--warn)}
label.opt{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center;padding:8px 12px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;margin-top:6px;cursor:pointer}
.f{margin-top:16px}
input[type=number]{font:inherit;padding:8px 10px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:8px;width:110px;background:#0f1220;color:var(--ink)}
.err{color:var(--warn);margin-top:8px;min-height:1.2em}
.credit{max-width:900px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 16px 24px;font-size:.78rem;color:var(--muted)}
@media (max-width:560px){table.m td.t{font-size:.82rem}table.m th{font-size:.62rem}table.m input{width:15px;height:15px}}
</style>

After each set you answer a few questions about the photos and how you felt. Please use a large screen if you can, in a quiet place. About 20 minutes.</p>'+

      for(var k in vals)if(!vals[k])return err('Please answer: '+Q[k].title);
      var b=this;b.disabled=true;
      var calls=[SPSite.answer('fear_dark',Number(fd)),SPSite.answer('age',age)];for(var k2 in vals)calls.push(SPSite.answer(k2,vals[k2]));
      Promise.all(calls).then(function(rs){var bad=rs.filter(function(r){return !ok(r);})[0];if(bad){b.disabled=false;return err(bad.error);}finish();});
    };
  }
  function finish(){
    app.innerHTML='<h1>Thank you!</h1><div class="card"><p id="fin">Submitting…</p><div class="err"></div></div>';
    SPSite.complete().then(function(r){if(!ok(r)){err(r.error||'Some answers are missing.');setTimeout(function(){var m=r.missing||[];if(m.indexOf('consent')>=0||m.indexOf('block_order')>=0)st.step='intro';else if(m.some(function(x){return /^(images|awe|panas)_/.test(x);})){st.step='blocks';st.b=0;st.k=0;st.q=0;st.phase='view';st.ready=false;}else st.step='about';save();route();},1800);}
      else{try{localStorage.removeItem('stars2025:state');}catch(e){}var s=document.getElementById('fin');if(s)s.textContent='Your answers are saved.';}});
  }
  function route(){if(st.step==='blocks')return st.phase==='rate'?rate():view();if(st.step==='about')return about();intro();}
  SPSite.onReady(function(ctx){
    ['consent','block_order','fear_dark','age','gender','ethnicity','student','education'].forEach(function(n){Q[n]=SPSite.getQuestion(n)||{};});
    ['urban','space','stars'].forEach(function(c){['images_','awe_','panas_'].forEach(function(p){Q[p+c]=SPSite.getQuestion(p+c)||{};});media[c]=(SPSite.getMedia(c)||[]).filter(function(f){return /\.(jpe?g|png|webp)$/i.test(f.name);});});
    var missing=['urban','space','stars'].filter(function(c){return media[c].length<1;});
    if(missing.length){app.innerHTML='<h1>Photographs missing</h1><p>Upload photographs to the media folders: '+missing.join(', ')+'.</p>';return;}
    try{st=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('stars2025:state'));}catch(e){st=null;}
    if(!st||!st.sets||['urban','space','stars'].some(function(c){return !st.sets[c]||st.sets[c].some(function(n){return !byName(c,n);});}))st=newState();
    var a=(ctx&&ctx.answers)||{};if(a.consent!==true)st.step='intro';
    save();route();
  });
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>

config.description: Within-subjects photo-viewing study. Participants view three sets of 7 photographs, each shown for 20 seconds: deep space images from the James Webb Space Telescope, starry night skies, and urban scenes without vegetation or water, in random order. After each set they rate the pleasantness and restorative potential of the images and their willingness to hang them in their room (1–10), the 30-item Awe Experience Scale (AWE-S, 1–7) and the I-PANAS-SF (1–5). Fear of the dark and demographics follow. Method replication of Martens, Prokopetz & Tomlinson (2025), International Journal of Psychology 61(1): e70146; the images are not the paper's stimuli.

paper.title: The Influence of Deep Space and the Stars on Emotions
